versions.changelog:
Initial release of the moving-averages skill.

- Provides guidance on using moving averages (MA) for trend analysis, including type, period, and combinations.
- Explains the four-week rule (Donchian breakout), the 4-9-18 day MA combo, and inherent limitations like lag and ineffectiveness in range-bound markets.
- Details activation scenarios and boundaries, clarifying when not to use this skill (e.g., oscillators or drawing trendlines).
- References case studies and best practices from John Murphy’s "Technical Analysis of the Futures Markets."
- Includes related skills for integration with trend frameworks and contrast with oscillators.
